## What does this change?

<!-- e.g. "Adds 2 places: X, Y" or "Fixes coordinates for Z" -->

## Checklist for new or edited places

- [ ] The coordinates point at the feature in **satellite view** (I checked at the suggested zoom)
- [ ] `googleMapsUrl` is `https://www.google.com/maps/@LAT,LNG,ZOOMz` with the same lat/lng/zoom as the entry
- [ ] `description` and `whyStrange` are in my own words (2–3 sentences, no copied text)
- [ ] `id` is a unique kebab-case slug; `tags` are kebab-case; `dateAdded` is today (YYYY-MM-DD)
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
